errors.text_span: Няма етикети с проценти вътре в секторите
errors.evidence: The figure reference states that percentages are written inside the corresponding sectors, so claiming there are no percent labels is incorrect.

errors.text_span: Диаграмата не включва легенда, но цветовете на секторите са показани вдясно.
errors.evidence: The figure clearly includes a legend on the left with colored dots, labels, and values; it is not absent nor located only as colors shown on the right.

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени в кръг без определен ред.
errors.evidence: The reference description says the sectors appear ordered by size from largest to smallest, so describing them as having no order is inaccurate.
As a pie chart, there are no axes to describe; no axis-description error applies.
